O R D E R Petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
2.
The petitioners are accused in Crime No.1712/2016 of Pudukkad Police Station registered for the offences under Sections 380, 411 and 454 IPC.
The case was registered on the basis of a complaint filed by the Assistant Commissioner (Food Safety Office), Thrissur.
The officers under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 took samples from the oil mill of the 1st petitioner and got it analysed at the scientific laboratory.
It was revealed that it did not comply with the prescribed standard.
So, the petitioners closed down the mill, locked and sealed the doors.
Later, it was revealed that the oil stored with mill was stolen.
The 2nd petitioner is the son of the 1st petitioner.
It was he who was conducting the mill on behalf of the 1st petitioner.
The prosecution case is that it was they who committed theft of the oil.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4. The 1st petitioner was the licencee of the mill and the 2nd petitioner who is his son was conducting it on his behalf, according to the prosecution.

When it came to the notice of the officers that the oil stocked in the mill did not comply with the prescribed standards, they closed down the mill and sealed its three doors which were of iron shutter.
Later, it was found that the oil was missing.
I have perused the case diary.
It is seen that the mill had a boundary wall on all its sides.
It had three shutters on one side.
All the three shutters were locked and sealed by the officers.
One shutter was broken open to enter the mill.
There is every reason to suspect that the petitioners are involved in the incident.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the 1st petitioner is aged 73 years and he is a cardiac patient and he has undergone a surgery recently.
Though he was the licencee, the mill was conducted by the 2nd petitioner.

Having regard to these facts, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the 1st petitioner; but the 2nd petitioner is not entitled to it.

sentences.text: 2 In the result, the bail application is allowed in part.

1) The 1st petitioner will be released on bail on his executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only), if he is arrested by the police in connection with this case.
2) He shall appear before the investigating officer for interrogation if he is so required by him in writing.
3) He shall not destroy or tamper with evidence.
In case of violation of any of the above conditions, the learned Magistrate is empowered to cancel the bail in accordance with the law.
The application is dismissed so far as the 2nd petitioner is concerned.
